title: NarrativeMandate
description: Phase 9 Narrative Intelligence contract: the chapter-level narrative mandate. It sits ABOVE the chapter objective and answers the four anti-流水账 questions — why THIS chapter must happen NOW, how far the conflict escalates vs the previous chapter, how the protagonist's inner arc moves, and what irreversible main-line advance it commits. It is a CROSS-CHAPTER projection folded from the previous mandate + StoryState (ADR-008), a DERIVED production artifact, not a registry fact.

authority.description: Structural invariant (ADR-009): the planner may prepare a narrative mandate, but committing to a book's tension arc / direction is an outward decision a human owns. This artifact stages a recommendation, never auto-executes an outward/irreversible transition.

gating.description: Structural invariant (ADR-003): a narrative mandate NEVER blocks a build. It is advisory production intent; an unmet mandate (a 温水章 / flat escalation / no net advance) is warned, not failed.

why_now.description: ① Why the protagonist must act NOW, not later (the anti-温水章 field).

cost_of_delay.description: none = no time pressure = 流水章 signal.

escalation.description: ② Whether conflict escalated vs the previous chapter (the cross-chapter tension ladder). from_level folds from the previous mandate's to_level (ADR-008).

inner_shift.description: ③ Whether the protagonist's psychology/belief moved (the anti-扁平主角 field). `from` folds from the previous mandate's `to` (ADR-008).

net_advance.description: ④ What main line this chapter net-advanced (the anti-原地打转 field).
